material_read: The white material presents as a smooth, semi-glossy plastic or a highly glazed, mass-produced ceramic. It has a distinct toy-like finish.
fix_direction: Eliminate all surface gloss and sheen to achieve a truly matte finish.
Introduce an ultra-controlled eggshell microtexture across the surface.
Ensure the material conveys a dry, dense, and engineered quality, moving away from a molded plastic aesthetic.
Incorporate sparse, fine hairline cracking to enhance the technical ceramic read.
Remove any visual cues that suggest a plastic or toy-like material.
summary: The white material fails significantly due to its glossy, plastic-like appearance, which directly contradicts the requirement for a matte, dry, and engineered technical ceramic. It lacks the specified microtexture and hairline cracking, resulting in an immediate read as a toy-like finish.
